title: Online UPI Phishing & Fake Payment Request
police_station: Cyber Crime Police Station, Central Range
disposition: Chargesheet Filed (Accused Traced via Bank Node)
modus_operandi: Victim received an urgent WhatsApp/SMS message with an APK or web link masquerading as an electricity bill update. Clicking prompted UPI PIN entry, routing funds to mule account.
description: Victim received a fake payment request through a messaging app and transferred money to an unknown account.

title: Mobile Phone Snatching from Transit Bus
disposition: Property Recovered via CEIR IMEI Tracking
modus_operandi: Thieves operated in pairs near rear footboard of crowded municipal transport bus; distracted victim during boarding and slipped mobile phone from pocket.
description: Mobile phone stolen from a public bus near the railway station while the victim was travelling.

title: Fake E-Commerce Social Ad Scam
disposition: Mule Accounts Frozen via Nodal Liaison
modus_operandi: Created sponsored social media advertisements offering electronics at 80% discount. Collected advance payments through temporary QR codes before dismantling the domain.
description: Customer paid for an online order through a website but never received the product. The website later became inaccessible.

title: ATM Skimming & Magnetic Strip Cloning
modus_operandi: Attached miniature magnetic card reader over ATM card slot accompanied by a pinhole camera on the keypad shield to capture PINs.
description: Card details were cloned from an ATM machine using a skimming device. Unauthorized withdrawals were made.

title: Daylight Motorcycle Chain Snatching
modus_operandi: Two motorcycle riders with masked faces targeted lone pedestrian on low-traffic service lane; pillion rider snatched gold chain with physical jerk causing victim to fall.
description: Gold chain was snatched by two persons on a motorcycle near a busy market road.

title: Residential House Burglary by Forced Entry
disposition: Latent Fingerprints Matched in Criminal Database
modus_operandi: Targeted locked residence whose residents were away on vacation; severed rear window grill using hydraulic iron shears and emptied main bedroom locker.
description: House was burgled while the family was away. Jewellery and electronics were stolen through forced entry.

title: Bank Officer Impersonation & OTP Fraud
disposition: Beneficiary Wallet Frozen at Payment Gateway
modus_operandi: Caller spoofed bank helpline number, warned customer of imminent credit card block, and induced customer to read out the SMS verification code.
description: Victim received a call from someone impersonating a bank official and was tricked into sharing OTP.

title: Boundary Dispute Assault with Hurt
modus_operandi: Dispute between adjacent landholders escalated into heated argument; accused used wooden club causing blunt force contusion to complainant's shoulder.
description: Person was assaulted during a neighbourhood property dispute. Injuries required medical attention.

title: Persistent Social Media Cyber Stalking
disposition: Accused Bound Over; Electronic Devices Confiscated
modus_operandi: Created multiple anonymous Instagram and Snapchat handles to track complainant's movements, sending unwanted explicit photos and threatening phone calls.
description: Woman reported repeated unwanted messages, calls and following by an acquaintance over several weeks.

title: Multi-Level High-Yield Ponzi Scheme
disposition: Director Assets Attached Under State Deposit Protection Act
modus_operandi: Promoted crypto-trading scheme promising 18% guaranteed monthly dividends; paid early returns using new deposits before founders fled overseas.
description: Victim invested money in a promised high-return scheme that later disappeared along with the money.

title: Marketplace Pickpocketing & Wallet Theft
disposition: CCTV Evidence Corroborated; Habitual Offender Convicted
modus_operandi: Slipped wallet from victim's trouser pocket amidst Sunday morning market crowd; immediately discarded credit cards in public bin and retained cash.
description: Wallet and phone were pickpocketed by a thief in a crowded market area.

title: Corporate Server Ransomware Encryption
disposition: Server Decrypted via Certified Incident Response Unit
modus_operandi: Exploited unpatched RDP port exposed on enterprise IP; executed LockBit variant encrypting SQL database, leaving ransom note with Tor address.
description: Business computer was infected with ransomware. Files were encrypted and a ransom demand was made.

title: Two-Wheeler Vehicle Theft from Residential Road
disposition: Vehicle Traced via Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR)
modus_operandi: Used master motorcycle key to unlock handle lock within 40 seconds; rode vehicle across district border to sell spare parts.
description: Two-wheeler was stolen from outside the apartment parking area. No CCTV was available.

title: Overseas Recruitment & Work Visa Scam
modus_operandi: Published bogus overseas airline job openings; required candidates to pay ₹25,000 for mandatory medical insurance and visa clearance certificates.
description: Job seeker paid a registration fee for a fake job offer through an online portal. No job was provided.

title: Identity Impersonation on Social Media
disposition: Impersonator Account Deleted; Restraining Order Issued
modus_operandi: Downloaded victim's profile pictures to set up clone Facebook account; solicited emergency loans from victim's contact list citing medical distress.
description: Suspect cloned citizen profile to request emergency money from contacts.
